page_title: UNI 0-2 AUG | Union Berlin v Augsburg 15/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' Laszlo Benes picks out Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin), who drives a shot just wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
88' The attendance is 21560.
87' Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Finn Dahmen, who smothers the ball.
84' That looked a certain handball by Robert Skov (Union Berlin) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
83' Robert Skov (Union Berlin) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
83' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
82' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The linesman makes the right call and Union Berlin will have a corner.

79' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just wide of the right post.
79' It seemed like Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
79' Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) replaces Chrislain Matsima.
75' Here comes a substitution. Alexis Claude-Maurice is given a rest as he is replaced by Mert Komur (Augsburg).
72' Union Berlin enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
69' Henri Koudossou goes off the pitch and Marius Wolf (Augsburg) comes on.
69' Steffen Baumgart prepares a substitution. Lucas Tousart is replaced by Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin).
68' Arne Maier pings in the corner towards the centre of the box and finds Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) unmarked, but his free header is woeful and slips well over the bar.
68' Arne Maier (Augsburg) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
66' The ball is cleared after Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
64' Flag up against Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
62' The substitution has been made. Robert Skov (Union Berlin) has replaced Jerome Roussillon.
60' Substitution. Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Samuel Essende walks off.
60' Jess Thorup has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Arne Maier (Augsburg) replacing Elvis Rexhbecaj.
60' Yellow card. Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
59' A substitution has been made. Woo-Yeong Jeong goes off and Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) comes on.
56' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
55' Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
54' Half-chance! Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) plays a pass into the box, but Finn Dahmen reacts well to snuff out the attack.
49' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
46' Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) fires a rebound from mid-range onto the bar!
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) comes off for Diogo Leite.
46' Half-time substitution. Aljoscha Kemlein is replaced by Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin).
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' The corner from Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) is intercepted by the defence.

44' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Augsburg win a corner kick.
41' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
39' Frank Willenborg blows his whistle and signals a foul after Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) brought his opponent down.
35' The linesman signals that Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
35' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) is caught offside!
33' Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) attacks the corner from Christopher Trimmel in the centre of the box, but his header lacks accuracy and goes high over the bar.
33' There's an opportunity for Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
30' 0 - 2 Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low shot that goes into the middle of the goal and past the goalkeeper.
27' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) tackles a bit over-zealously and Frank Willenborg blows for a foul.
23' Frank Willenborg blows his whistle as Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
20' Henri Koudossou (Augsburg) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
20' Henri Koudossou (Augsburg) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
18' A dangerous looking corner kick from Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is cleared to safety by the defence.
18' A rebound sits up nicely for Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin), whose shot from distance is blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Union Berlin.
18' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the corner but it's cleared.

17' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Union Berlin win a corner.
15' What a chance that is! Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the right post.
13' Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
11' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

11' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He latches on to a precise pass and fires a decent first-time shot towards the bottom right corner from a promising distance, but Finn Dahmen denies him. Union Berlin will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
9' 0 - 1 Goal! Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot into the top right corner. It's 0:1.

8' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Alexander Schwolow guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
6' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
3' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Henri Koudossou (Augsburg). Frank Willenborg saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Augsburg will kick-off.
Frank Willenborg is the one to supervise the game today.
